open_errors.issue: Vellan has never told Devan Asha's last words. In ch 5 at the lightning boulder he refused ('When I've earned saying it'). Ch 8 says he 'had not repeated' them 'since the pass', which implies he once said them. He only gives them in ch 27.
open_errors.fix: Say he has not spoken of the words again since the boulder.

patches.find: He had not repeated Asha's last words since the pass, and Devan had not asked.
patches.replace: He had not spoken again of Asha's last words since the boulder, and Devan had not asked.

open_errors.issue: Neela recalls Usha warning her 'at the shelter' not to touch the throat paste. At the shelter Usha said only a few sentences, and her dawn message was two lines. Neela had not yet planned to pass as a guard. Muthu is the one who taught her the cuffs and the lime-and-ochre paste, by the water jars in ch 9.
open_errors.fix: Attribute the warning to Muthu at the water jars.

patches.find: *Don't touch it,* Usha had said, at the shelter. *Not once. A hand at the throat is a tell.*
patches.replace: *Don't touch it,* Muthu had said, by the water jars. *Not once. A hand at the throat is a tell.*

open_errors.issue: Neela 'had stood below it all her childhood'. Her childhood was in Nellimala until she was six and then in the Resin House in the Blackbark Wood. She knows Kodiyur only from her cover and her first contract, and ch 3 says she had seen the palace only 'as a pale shape from the quay'.
open_errors.fix: Make it a sight from the quay, years ago, not a childhood one.

patches.find: She had stood below it all her childhood and seen nothing but a wall.
patches.replace: She had stood below it on the quay, years ago, and seen nothing but a wall.

open_errors.issue: The queen's rider arrives after noon has passed, and Devan writes his refusal on the arrow cart that afternoon. The chapter's last section, at dusk, says he gave up the office 'that morning'.

patches.find: He had given up the office that morning and the old man hadn't noticed.
patches.replace: He had given up the office that afternoon and the old man hadn't noticed.

open_errors.issue: In ch 22, on the evening the queen arrives, Neela promises to tell the Company her answer 'Tonight, at the cairn fire'. Ch 23 is the next day. So in ch 24, the afternoon after ch 23's middle watch, the cairn-fire telling was two nights back, not 'last night'.
open_errors.fix: Date the cairn-fire telling to the night the queen came.

patches.find: Last night, at the cairn fire, she had told the Company what she meant to say.
patches.replace: The night the queen came, at the cairn fire, she had told the Company what she meant to say.

open_errors.issue: Kuttu, bound to Bhaskaran, is the boar that fights at Bhaskaran's shoulder in ch 25. In ch 24 he sets 'a forepaw' on a stake point. A boar has trotters, not paws.
open_errors.fix: Use a neutral word that fits a hoofed shape.

patches.find: Kuttu, in shape, set a forepaw on a stake point, and Bhaskaran, ten paces off at the wall, swore and shook his hand.
patches.replace: Kuttu, in shape, set a forefoot on a stake point, and Bhaskaran, ten paces off at the wall, swore and shook his hand.

open_errors.issue: Devan made the slow two-finger drill the winter after the ford, at twenty-five, and ch 2 says he has spent seven years on it. In ch 32 he says 'eight years on a drill'.
open_errors.fix: Change eight to seven to match ch 2.

patches.find: I spent eight years on a drill that needed both hands, and it took a spear to teach me I'd only learned half of it.
patches.replace: I spent seven years on a drill that needed both hands, and it took a spear to teach me I'd only learned half of it.
